hero.title: A home for *skateboarding*
hero.lede: HIC Warehouse is an indoor and outdoor skatepark in Aiken, run by Home for Skateboarding, a nonprofit that serves the community through mentoring, recreation and education for all ages.

items.title: Indoor and outdoor park
items.text: Room to skate whatever the weather.

items.title: Lessons
items.text: Thursdays, 4:30 to 5:30 pm or 5:30 to 6:30 pm. Call to schedule.

items.title: Bands on weekend nights
items.text: Sometimes the park stays open until midnight.

items.title: Waivers
items.text: A parent signs for skaters under 18.

items.title: Mentoring
items.text: Support for the kids who need it.

sections.title: Giving back *to Aiken’s skaters*
body: Home for Skateboarding was founded by Bo Mitchell, an actor, entrepreneur and professional skater, known for playing Wayne Powers on HBO’s Eastbound & Down.
Bo grew up in Aiken, skating since he was a child, and knew there was no place for kids here to practice. He started HIC Warehouse to give back to the children of the community.

He uses his connections to bring popular skaters to the park to talk with kids and show them tricks, introduces young skaters with the talent and drive to sponsors, and takes them to competitions in other states, such as California.

sections.title: Under 18? Bring a parent the first time
sections.text: A parent or guardian signs the waiver before you skate.
